'''Amadaine 24 (July 2)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - Party at [[Barthanes]]' manor. [[Rand]] talks with [[Thom]] again. He, [[Hurin]] and [[Loial]] find a [[Waygate]] in the manor's grounds. When Rand opens it, ''[[Machin Shin]]'' is waiting. Barthanes gives Rand a message from [[Fain]]. Rand decides to go to [[Toman Head]].
